name: travel-long-v1
status: incomplete draft: fields not set here are undecided, not inherited; phase 3 fills in the full profile before any reader uses it
_doc: Style profile of the Travel long Format (ADR 0009), one full profile with no inheritance. Only the author's decisions so far are set: canvas, speech, pacing, ending, audio, render; fields not set here are undecided, not taken from the root style.json (the Walk Reel profile). No code reads this file yet: cf.build, cf.render, cf.canvas, cf.render_check, cf.script_schema, Desk Script validation (cf/desk/videos_api.py) and overlays/render.mjs read the root style.json until phase 3. canvas.fps 29.97 is fractional; cf.canvas.Canvas.fps is an int today and would truncate it to 29, so phase 3 makes fps fractional first.
